Caring for children, supporting each other

BAPHON connects pediatric hematology/oncology nurses across Northern California through education, networking, and advocacy for our patients and families.

Join BAPHON Upcoming Events

Who We Are

BAPHON is the Bay Area local chapter of APHON (Association of Pediatric Hematology/Oncology Nurses), a national professional organization dedicated to optimal nursing care for children and adolescents with cancer and their families.

We plan educational events and an annual symposium, as well as networking opportunities for our chapter members and other interested nurses throughout Northern California.

Membership

Why Join BAPHON?

  • Connect with a local community of pediatric hematology/oncology nurses who understand your work.
  • Take part in educational events and an annual symposium to stay current in the field.
  • Build relationships with Bay Area colleagues who share your commitment to improving care for children with cancer.
  • Strengthen your professional network through a chapter that combines learning, collaboration, and support.

Supporters & Exhibitors

BAPHON depends on and is grateful for the organizations that help make our educational events outstanding. By supporting BAPHON, your organization demonstrates its commitment to pediatric hematology/oncology nursing education across Northern California. Your support helps us host CE dinners, symposiums, and provide educational opportunities to our chapter members.

Questions? Contact our Sponsor Liaison: sponsors@baphon.org

Levels of Support

All supporters will be recognized on the BAPHON website.

Platinum
$5,500
  • ✦ Table at two-day Annual Symposium (April 30–May 1)
  • ✦ Company logo in conference program
  • ✦ Logo display at breakfast, lunch, & breaks
  • ✦ Company logo on Sponsor Bingo Card
  • ✦ Logo displayed on welcome tote bag
  • ✦ Dedicated logo/info slide in conference slideshow
  • ✦ Table at both CE Dinners (Winter & Fall)

$4,500
  • ✦ Table at two-day Annual Symposium (April 30–May 1)
